body.name: exact algebraic-dependency derivative-separated class
body.construction:
The algebraic-dependency derivative-separated class is
\[
\begin{split}
 \mathcal M_{uv,\mathrm{alg}}^{\partial}
 &(d,m,G;\gamma,L,d_{\min},d_{\max},\kappa)\\
 ={}&\left\{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cmp}}(d,m,G;\gamma,L,d_{\min},d_{\max}):
 m\text{ is odd},\right.\\
 &\left.\qquad
 \min_{i\in V_{uv}^{\mathrm{alg},m}}m|A_{ii}|^{m-1}\ge\kappa,
 \quad
 \min_{j\to i\in E_{uv}^{\mathrm{alg},m}}|C_m(A_{ii},A_{jj})|\ge\kappa
 \right\}.
\end{split}
\]
When \(u\to v\in G\), both finite index sets in the minima are nonempty because \(u\to v\in E_{uv}^{\mathrm{alg},m}\) and \(u,v\in V_{uv}^{\mathrm{alg},m}\).
